images.filename: Field, but not for long - geograph.org.uk - 212622.jpg
images.caption: Field, but not for long. Port William has grown over the years, as evidenced by the '40s map. This field, at the north end of the town, is earmarked for a new housing estate. The photo is taken from the road which will be one of the entrances. Looking north, the ancient sea cliff can be seen to the right, which indicates that the new houses will be built on a 'raised beach'. I wonder what effect global warming will have on sea levels here?
